name: mailbridge-mcp
description: Safely search, read, draft, and explicitly send mail through accounts configured in macOS Mail.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Grok safely to macOS Mail.
interface.longDescription: A local-only STDIO bridge to accounts already configured in macOS Mail, with bounded reads, first-run account scoping, a host-agnostic send preview, and per-send confirmation for outbound mail.
defaultPrompt: List my Mail accounts and save an allowlist before searching.
Read my latest three Inbox messages in one chosen account.
Preview an exact reply, show it, and send only after I approve that content.
